title.zh: 卷十五 本紀第十五 神宗二
title.raw: 卷十五 本紀第十五 神宗二 Volume 15 Annals 15: Shenzong 2

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，錄唐李氏、周柴氏後。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day guichou: descendants of Tang’s Li clan and Zhou’s Chai clan were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, year three, guichou: the court registered heirs of Tang’s Lis and Zhou’s Chais.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸路散青苗錢禁抑配。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: all circuits were to disburse Green Sprouts funds and forbid forced allotment.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, circuits were ordered to release Green Sprouts money and ban coerced quotas.

sentences.zh: 戊午，判尚書省張方平罷知陳州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Zhang Fangping, who adjudicated the Secretariat, was dismissed and made Chen prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhang Fangping left the Secretariat for Chen prefect.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，以翰林學士司馬光爲樞密副使，凡九辭，詔收還敕誥。

translations.literal: Second month, day renshen: Hanlin academician Sima Guang was made vice military affairs commissioner; he declined nine times; the throne recalled his commission and patent.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renshen: Sima Guang was named vice military commissioner and refused nine times until the patent was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以河州刺史瞎欺丁木征爲金紫光祿大夫、檢校刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Hezhou chief Xiqin Ding Muzheng was made grand mentor of the golden purple-girdle class and acting minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Hezhou chief Xiqin Ding Muzheng received golden purple-girdle grand mentor rank and acting justice minister.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，韓琦罷河北安撫使，爲大名府路安撫使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Han Qi left the Hebei pacification commission and became Daming circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Han Qi moved from Hebei pacification to Daming circuit.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，孫覺、呂公著、張戩、程顥、李常上疏極言新法，不聽。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: Sun Jue, Lü Gongzhu, Zhang Zhan, Cheng Hao, and Li Chang memorialized fiercely against the new laws; the throne did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingshen: Sun Jue, Lü Gongzhu, Zhang Zhan, Cheng Hao, and Li Chang assailed the new laws; the throne turned them away.

sentences.zh: 己亥，始策進士，罷詩、賦、論三題。

translations.literal: Day jihai: for the first time the palace examination was held; poetry, fu, and discourse topics were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the civil examination began without poetry, fu, or essay questions.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李常言青苗斂散不實，有旨具析，翰林學士兼知通進、銀台司范鎮封還詔書，以爲不當，坐罷職，守本官。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Li Chang said Green Sprouts collection and disbursement were false; an order demanded particulars; Hanlin academician and Silver Terrace director Fan Zhen returned the edict as improper and was dismissed from office, keeping his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Li Chang exposed false Green Sprouts accounts; Fan Zhen returned the edict and lost his post but kept rank.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜禮部奏名進士、明經及第八百二十九人。

translations.literal: Day renzi: eight hundred twenty-nine presented scholars and classicists from the Ministry of Rites were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, 829 examination graduates received degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸路毋有留獄。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: no circuit was to hold prisoners overlong.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, circuits were forbidden to keep cases in jail without end.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，立試刑法及詳刑官。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: trial-by-penal-code and detailed-penal offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, penal-code examination and detailed-review posts were created.

sentences.zh: 右正言孫覺以奉詔反覆，貶知廣德軍。

translations.literal: Right remonstrator Sun Jue was demoted to Guangde military prefect for repeatedly reversing imperial orders.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jue, who had reversed edicts too often, was sent to Guangde military prefect.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，幸金明池觀水嬉，宴射瓊林苑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: the emperor visited Golden Bright Pool for water games and feasted with archery at Jade Forest Park.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guihai: he watched water games at Golden Bright Pool and shot at Jade Forest Park.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遼遣耶律寬來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Liao sent Yelü Kuan to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yelü Kuan came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，給兩浙轉運司度僧牒，募民入粟。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the two Zhe circuits’ transport office received monk-sale quotas to buy grain from the people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhe transport got monk quotas to trade grain from farmers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，御史中丞呂公著貶知潁州。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: investigating censor-in-chief Lü Gongzhu was demoted to Ying prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Lü Gongzhu was sent to Ying prefect.

sentences.zh: 己卯，趙抃罷知杭州，以韓絳參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Zhao Bian left Hangzhou prefect; Han Jiang became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhao Bian left Hangzhou and Han Jiang joined the council.

sentences.zh: 監察御史裏行程顥罷爲京西路同提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Supervising censor trainee Cheng Hao was dismissed and made co-director of penal affairs on the Jingxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Hao left the censorate for Jingxi co-penal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，右正言李常貶通判滑州，監察御史裏行張戩貶知公安縣，王子韶貶知上元縣。

translations.literal: Day renwu: right remonstrator Li Chang was demoted to Huazhou vice prefect; supervising censor trainee Zhang Zhan to Gong’an county; Wang Zishao to Shangyuan county.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Li Chang went to Huazhou, Zhang Zhan to Gong’an, Wang Zishao to Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，侍御史知雜事陳襄罷爲同修起居注，程顥簽書鎮寧軍節度判官公事，前秀州軍事判官李定爲太子中允、監察御史裏行。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: attendant censor Chen Xiang was dismissed to co-compiler of the daily record; Cheng Hao signed as Zhenning military judge; former Xiuzhou military judge Li Ding became crown prince attendant and supervising censor trainee.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Chen Xiang left the censorate; Cheng Hao signed at Zhenning; Li Ding entered as censor trainee.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，詔並邊州郡毋給青苗錢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi, edict: frontier prefectures and counties were not to issue Green Sprouts funds.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guisi: border counties were barred from Green Sprouts loans.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔令司馬光詳定轉對封事。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: Sima Guang was to fix the sealed memorials from palace audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Sima Guang was ordered to compile audience memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔罷制置三司條例歸中書。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: the Fiscal Reform Commission was abolished and returned to the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Fiscal Reform Commission was folded back into the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜進士蘇丕號安退處士。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: presented scholar Su Pi was titled Retired Gentleman of Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Su Pi received the title Retired Gentleman of Peace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷入閣儀。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the entering-the-palace audience rite was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the inner-palace audience ceremony ended.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以審官院爲東院，別置西院。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: the Personnel Evaluation Eastern Court became the eastern court; a western court was separately established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Personnel Evaluation split into eastern and western courts.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，日有五色雲。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: the sun showed five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiyou: five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封宗室秦、魯、蔡、魏、燕、陳、越七王后爲公。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: seven imperial clansmen—Qin, Lu, Cai, Wei, Yan, Chen, and Yue—were enfeoffed as dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, seven princes of the blood were made dukes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔修武成王廟。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: the Martial Completion King temple was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Martial Completion King shrine was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，知諫院胡宗愈貶通判真州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: remonstrance official Hu Zongyu was demoted to Zhenzhou vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hu Zongyu was sent to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，歐陽修徙知蔡州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: Ouyang Xiu was moved to Cai prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinmao: Ouyang Xiu became Cai prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，呂公弼罷樞密使，以知太原府馮京爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Lü Gongbi left the military commission; Taiyuan prefect Feng Jing became vice military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Lü Gongbi left the Military Commission and Feng Jing became vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 罷潞州交子務。

translations.literal: The Luzhou paper-money office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou’s paper-money bureau closed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, hail struck.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詳定宗室襲封制度。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the system for imperial clansmen’s hereditary enfeoffment was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, clan inheritance rules were codified.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，置三班院主簿。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a registrar was established for the Three-Rank Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Three-Rank Court gained a registrar.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，罷看詳銀台司文字所。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu: the Silver Terrace review office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuwu: the Silver Terrace review desk closed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以旱慮囚，死罪以下遞減一等，杖、笞者釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: because of drought, prisoners were reviewed; death sentences were reduced one degree in succession; those under the cudgel were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, drought amnesty stepped death sentences down and freed the lightly punished.

sentences.zh: 以衛州旱，令轉運司振恤，仍蠲租賦。

translations.literal: Because Weizhou suffered drought, the transport office was to give relief and rent and tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou’s drought brought transport relief and tax remission.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔川陝、福建、廣南七路官令轉運司立格就注，具爲令。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: in Sichuan-Shaanxi, Fujian, and the seven southern circuits, prefectural and county officials were to be appointed by transport-office quotas; this became statute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, seven southern and western circuits fixed official appointments through transport quotas.

sentences.zh: 遣張景憲等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Zhang Jingxian and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingxian’s mission left for Liao’s birthday and New Year.

sentences.zh: 己卯，夏人犯大順城，知慶州李復圭以方略授環慶路鈐轄李信、慶州東路都巡檢劉甫、監押種詠出戰，兵少取敗。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Xia raided Dashun fortress; Qing prefect Li Fugui by plan sent Huanqing circuit controller Li Xin, eastern Qing inspector Liu Fu, and commissary Zhong Yong to battle; few troops brought defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Xia hit Dashun; Li Fugui sent Li Xin and Liu Fu with too few men and lost.

sentences.zh: 復圭誣信等違其節制，斬信及劉甫，種詠死於獄。

translations.literal: Fugui charged Xin and the others with disobeying his orders; Xin and Liu Fu were beheaded; Zhong Yong died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Fugui blamed his officers; Li Xin and Liu Fu were executed and Zhong Yong died in jail.

sentences.zh: 是月，慶州巡檢姚兕敗夏人于荔原堡。

translations.literal: That month, Qing inspector Yao Ni defeated Xia at Liyuan fortress.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yao Ni beat Xia at Liyuan fortress.

sentences.zh: 鈐轄郭慶、都監高敏死之。

translations.literal: Controller Guo Qing and superintendent Gao Min died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Qing and Gao Min fell in the same fighting.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子朔，中書置檢正官。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi, first of month: examining officials were placed in the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuzi new moon: the Chancellery gained examining officers.

sentences.zh: 乙未，韓絳罷爲陝西宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Han Jiang was dismissed and made Shaanxi pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Han Jiang left the council for Shaanxi pacification.

sentences.zh: 己亥，始試法官。

translations.literal: Day jihai: penal judges were first examined.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the first penal-law examinations were held.

sentences.zh: 庚子，曾公亮罷爲司空兼侍中、河陽三城節度使。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zeng Gongliang was dismissed and made minister of works with palace attendant and Heyang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zeng Gongliang left the council for works minister and Heyang command.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以馮京參知政事，翰林學士吳充爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Feng Jing became participating administrator; Hanlin academician Wu Chong became vice military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Feng Jing joined the council and Wu Chong became vice military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，親策賢良方正及武舉。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the worthy-and-upright and military examinations were personally held.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the throne personally examined worthy-and-upright candidates and military graduates.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，作東、西府以居執政。

translations.literal: Day guichou: eastern and western offices were built to house the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, east and west ministerial offices were erected.

sentences.zh: 司馬光罷知永興軍。

translations.literal: Sima Guang was dismissed and made Yongxing military prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang left court for Yongxing military prefect.

sentences.zh: 詔環慶陣亡義勇余丁當刺者，悉免之。

translations.literal: Edict: in Huanqing, all righteous volunteers and remaining households of the slain who should have been tattooed for service were wholly exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Huanqing’s volunteer dead and their households were freed from the tattooed-service levy.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，詔延州毋納夏使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou, edict: Yanzhou was not to receive Xia envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinyou: Yanzhou was ordered to turn Xia envoys away.

sentences.zh: 甲子，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: trees bore ice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, glaze ice sheathed the trees.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朝謁神御殿。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the court visited the spirit-hall of imperial portraits.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the court bowed at the imperial portrait hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，知慶州李復圭擅興兵敗績，誣裨將李信、劉甫、種詠以死，御史劾之，貶保靜軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Qing prefect Li Fugui was charged with launching troops on his own authority, defeat, and framing staff officers Li Xin, Liu Fu, and Zhong Yong to their deaths; the censorate impeached him; he was demoted to Baojing military vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Li Fugui was punished for unauthorized war, defeat, and framing Li Xin, Liu Fu, and Zhong Yong to death.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，陳升之以母憂去位。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Chen Shengzhi left office for his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Chen Shengzhi withdrew for mourning.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔罷諸場務內侍監當。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, edict: eunuch supervisors at market posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, eunuch overseers of market offices were removed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，振河北饑民徙京西者。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: Hebei famine refugees moving to Jingxi were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuzi: Hebei refugees on the western road received grain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，官節行之士二十一人。

translations.literal: Day jichou: twenty-one men of official festival duty were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, twenty-one festival officers were named.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，蠲陝西蕃部貸糧。

translations.literal: Day renchen: loan grain to western Fan tribes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Fan loan grain in Shaanxi was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，授布衣王存下班殿侍、三班差使、宣撫司指揮使。

translations.literal: Day guimao: commoner Wang Cun was granted lower palace attendant, three-rank envoy, and pacification command commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wang Cun rose from commoner to palace attendant and pacification envoy.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，夏人寇大順城，都監燕達等擊走之。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xia raided Dashun fortress; superintendent Yan Da and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yan Da beat back Xia at Dashun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔升朝官除南郊赦封贈父母外，不得以加恩轉官。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: except for southern-suburb amnesty gifts to parents, court officials were not to gain rank through favor extensions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, favor promotions were barred except for suburban gifts to parents.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以韓絳兼河東宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Han Jiang was also made Hedong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Han Jiang added Hedong pacification.

sentences.zh: 梓州路轉運使韓璹等以能興利除害，賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Zizhou circuit transport commissioner Han Lin and others, for increasing revenue and removing harm, were given silk by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Han Lin and other transport commissioners were rewarded for raising revenue without ruin.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，詔立諸路更戍法，舊以他路兵雜戍者遣還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei, edict: the circuit rotation garrison law was established; troops from other circuits mixed in garrisons were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiwei: the rotation garrison law sent foreign-circuit troops home.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，立保甲法。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the community militia law was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the baojia militia system was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以韓絳、王安石並同中書門下平章事，王珪參知政事。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Han Jiang and Wang Anshi were both made co-chancellors; Wang Gui became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Han Jiang and Wang Anshi entered the council; Wang Gui joined them.

sentences.zh: 賜布衣陳知彥進士出身，知縣王輔同進士出身。

translations.literal: Commoner Chen Zhiyan was granted presented-scholar status; county magistrate Wang Fu received the same.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhiyan and magistrate Wang Fu were both made presented scholars.

sentences.zh: 庚午，夏人寇鎮戎軍三川砦，巡檢趙普伏兵邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xia raided Zhenrong army’s Sanchuan stockade; inspector Zhao Pu ambushed and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Zhao Pu ambushed Xia at Sanchuan stockade.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，增廣南攝官奉。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: salaries of southern acting officials were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, southern acting officials received higher pay.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，初行免役法。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the exemption-from-corvée law was first implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the exemption-from-corvée law took effect.

sentences.zh: 賜西蕃董氈詔並衣帶、鞍馬。

translations.literal: Western Fan Dong Zhan was given an edict with robes, belt, and saddle horse.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhan of the western Fan received robes, belt, and horse from the throne.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命王安石提舉編修三司令式。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Wang Anshi was ordered to direct compilation of the three departments’ standard regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Anshi took charge of revising the three departments’ regulations.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遼遣蕭遵道等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Liao sent Xiao Zundao and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命宋敏求詳定命官、使臣過犯。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Song Minqiu was ordered to fix regulations on official and envoy offenses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Song Minqiu was told to codify official and envoy penalties.

sentences.zh: 是歲，振河北、陝西旱饑，除民租。

translations.literal: That year, Hebei and Shaanxi drought famine were relieved and the people’s rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year, drought famine in Hebei and Shaanxi brought relief and rent cuts.

sentences.zh: 交阯入貢，廣源、下溪州蠻來附。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi sent tribute; Guangyuan and Xiaxi Fan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi paid tribute; Guangyuan and Xiaxi tribes came in.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁亥朔，不視朝。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day dinghai, first of month: the court did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, year four, dinghai new moon: no court audience.

sentences.zh: 己丑，種諤襲夏兵於囉兀北，大敗之，遂城囉兀。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Zhong E raided Xia north of Luowu and routed them, then walled Luowu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zhong E smashed Xia north of Luowu and fortified the place.

sentences.zh: 自是夏人日聚兵爲報復計，言者以諤爲稔邊患不便。

translations.literal: Thereafter Xia daily gathered troops for revenge; memorialists said Zhong E was ripening border trouble and should be removed.
translations.idiomatic: Xia then massed for revenge; critics said Zhong E was brewing border war and should go.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，王安石請鬻天下廣惠倉田爲三路及京東常平倉本，從之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wang Anshi asked to sell empire-wide Broad Relief granary fields as capital for the three circuits’ and eastern capital ever-normal granaries; assent.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wang Anshi won permission to sell Broad Relief fields to fund ever-normal granaries.

sentences.zh: 乙未，渝州夷賊李光吉叛，巡檢李宗閔等戰死，命夔州路轉運使孫構討平之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Yuzhou Yi bandit Li Guangji rebelled; inspectors Li Zongmin and others died in battle; Kuizhou circuit transport commissioner Sun Gou was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Li Guangji rebelled in Yuzhou; Li Zongmin fell and Sun Gou was sent to crush him.

sentences.zh: 詔詳定大辟覆讞法。

translations.literal: Edict: the law for review of capital cases was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-case review law was codified.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝謁太祖、太宗神御殿。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the court visited the spirit portraits of Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Taizu and Taizong were honored at the portrait hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸集禧觀，宴從臣，又幸大相國寺，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the emperor visited Jixi Abbey, feasted his followers, then the Great Xiangguo Temple, and watched lamps from Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, he feasted at Jixi Abbey, visited Xiangguo Temple, and watched lamps from Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 韓絳等言種諤領兵入西界，斬獲甚衆，詔遣使撫問。

translations.literal: Han Jiang and others said Zhong E had led troops into the western border with many kills and captures; an envoy was sent to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jiang reported Zhong E’s western victories; an envoy was sent to reward him.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，停括牧地。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the seizure of pasture land was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, pasture confiscation stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立京東、河北賊盜重法。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: heavy laws against bandits in eastern and Hebei circuits were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, harsh bandit laws were set for the east and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷永興軍買鹽鈔場。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Yongxing army salt-certificate market was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yongxing’s salt-certificate market closed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，定文德殿朔望視朝儀。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: audience rites at Wende Hall on new and full moons were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wende Hall new- and full-moon audiences were regulated.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳朔，罷詩賦及明經諸科，以經義、論、策試進士。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingsi, first of month: poetry-fu and classicist subjects were abolished; classics exposition, discourse, and policy tested presented scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingsi new moon: examinations turned to classics, discourse, and policy alone.

sentences.zh: 置京東西、陝西、河東、河北路學官，使之教導。

translations.literal: School officers were established on the eastern, Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei circuits to teach and guide.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit school officers were appointed in the east, Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔治吏沮青苗法者。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: officials who obstructed the Green Sprouts law were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, obstructors of Green Sprouts were threatened with punishment.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔振河北民乏食者。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: Hebei people lacking food were to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, starving Hebei households received relief grain.

sentences.zh: 賻恤西界戰死軍人。

translations.literal: Western-border soldiers who died in battle were compensated.
translations.idiomatic: Families of soldiers killed on the western border were paid.

sentences.zh: 庚午，于闐國來貢。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Khotan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Khotan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬申，進封高密郡王頵爲嘉王。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Prince of Gaomi Jun was advanced to Prince of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince Jun of Gaomi became Prince of Jia.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔審官院所定人赴中書，察堪任者引見。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: men fixed by the Personnel Evaluation Court were to come to the Chancellery; those judged fit were presented.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Personnel Evaluation nominees were to be interviewed at the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜討渝州夷賊兵特支錢。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: special funds were granted troops who fought Yuzhou Yi bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Yuzhou campaign troops received special pay.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 詔增漳河等役兵。

translations.literal: Edict: corvée troops on the Zhang and other rivers were increased.
translations.idiomatic: River corvée labor on the Zhang and other streams was increased.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，夏人陷撫寧堡。

translations.literal: Third month, day dinghai: Xia took Funing fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dinghai: Xia captured Funing fortress.

sentences.zh: 戊子，慶州廣銳卒叛，尋討平之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Guangrui troops at Qingzhou mutinied and were soon suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Qingzhou’s Guangrui garrison mutinied and was quickly crushed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔給諸路學田，增教官員。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: school fields were granted to all circuits and teaching staff increased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, every circuit received school lands and more teachers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣使察奉行新法不職者。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: envoys were sent to inspect failures in implementing the new laws.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, inspectors were sent to find negligent reform officials.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，減河東、陝西路囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Hedong and Shaanxi prisoners’ crimes were reduced one degree; those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Shaanxi and Hedong jails received one-grade sentence cuts.

sentences.zh: 民緣軍事科役者，蠲其租賦。

translations.literal: People whose rent was taken for military levies had rent and tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Rent and tax were forgiven where military levies had drained the fields.

sentences.zh: 丙午，種諤坐陷撫寧堡，責授汝州團練副使、潭州安置。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhong E, for losing Funing fortress, was demoted to Ruzhou training vice commissioner and assigned to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhong E was punished for Funing’s fall with exile to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，韓絳坐興師敗衄罷，以本官知鄧州。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Han Jiang was dismissed for launching troops and suffering defeat, and made Deng prefect in his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Han Jiang lost the council after military defeat and went to Deng prefect.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錄唐李氏後。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: descendants of Tang’s Li clan were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Tang Li heirs were registered again.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰朔，恤刑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen, first of month: penalties were tempered.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingchen new moon: punishments were reviewed and eased.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遼遣蕭廣等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Liao sent Xiao Guang and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣環慶都鈐轄幵贇以兵屯邠、涇、河中，以備西夏。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Huanqing controller Qian Yun was sent with troops to garrison Bin, Jing, and Hezhong against Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Qian Yun massed troops on Bin, Jing, and Hezhong against Xia.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷陝西交子法。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Shaanxi paper-money law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Shaanxi paper money ended.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，司馬光權判西京留台。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Sima Guang was made acting western capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Sima Guang became acting western capital regent.

sentences.zh: 種諤再貶賀州別駕。

translations.literal: Zhong E was demoted again to Hezhou registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong E was further demoted to Hezhou registrar.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔司農寺月進諸路所上雨雪狀。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: the Finance Commission was to submit monthly each circuit’s rain and snow reports.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, circuits were to file monthly weather reports with Finance.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣使按視宿、亳等州災傷，仍令修飭武備。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: envoys were sent to inspect disaster damage in Su, Bo, and other prefectures and to ready defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, inspectors toured Su and Bo disasters and ordered defenses tightened.

sentences.zh: 壬午，定進士考轉官。

translations.literal: Day renwu: regulations on presented scholars’ promotion were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, graduate promotion rules were codified.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，右諫議大夫呂晦卒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: right remonstrator Lü Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: Lü Hui died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔許富弼養疾西京。

translations.literal: Day renyin, edict: Fu Bi was permitted to nurse illness in the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Fu Bi was allowed to convalesce in the western capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高麗國來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Goryeo presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔宗室率府副率以上，遭父母喪及嫡孫承重，並解官行服。

translations.literal: Day xinhai, edict: imperial clansmen from deputy commandant of the heir’s guard upward who suffered parents’ mourning or bore the chief grandson’s burden were all to leave office and observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, senior clansmen in mourning were ordered to leave office and wear white.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔恩、冀等州災傷，遣使振恤，蠲其稅。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: in En, Ji, and other disaster prefectures, envoys were sent to relieve and taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, disaster prefectures received relief envoys and tax cuts.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，河北饑民爲盜者，減死刺配。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Hebei famine refugees who became bandits had death reduced to tattooed exile.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingsi: starving Hebei bandits were tattooed instead of executed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，群臣三上尊號曰紹天法古文武仁孝皇帝，不許。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the ministers three times offered the title Continuing Heaven, Patterning Antiquity, Civil, Martial, Reverent, Benevolent Emperor; refused.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the cabinet’s third honorific title was refused.

sentences.zh: 甲子，歐陽修以太子少師致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Ouyang Xiu retired as heir’s grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Ouyang Xiu retired as heir’s grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the prisons were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，富弼坐格青苗法，徙判汝州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Fu Bi, for obstructing the Green Sprouts law, was moved to judge Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Fu Bi was punished for blocking Green Sprouts and sent to Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，層檀國來貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: the Sandalwood country sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuzi: Sandalwood envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振恤兩浙水災。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the two Zhe circuits’ flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhe flood victims received aid.

sentences.zh: 乙未，錄死事將校崔達子遇爲三班奉職。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: fallen commander Cui Da’s son Yu was recorded as third-rank attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Cui Da’s son Yu was enrolled as third-rank attendant.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，監察御史裏行劉摯罷監衡州鹽倉，御史中丞楊繪貶知鄭州。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: supervising censor trainee Liu Zhi was dismissed to oversee Hengzhou salt depot; censor-in-chief Yang Hui was demoted to Zheng prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Liu Zhi left for Hengzhou salt depot and Yang Hui for Zheng prefect.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔宗室不得祀祖宗神御。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: imperial clansmen were forbidden to sacrifice at ancestral spirit portraits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, clansmen were barred from private ancestral portrait rites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔唐、鄧給流民田。

translations.literal: Day dingwei, edict: Tang and Deng were to give fields to wandering refugees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Tang and Deng were told to settle refugees on land.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑朔，高麗來貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou, first of month: Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guichou new moon: Goryeo tribute arrived.

sentences.zh: 遣官體量陝西差役新法及民間利害。

translations.literal: Officials were sent to measure Shaanxi’s corvée reforms and popular harm and benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors were sent to weigh Shaanxi corvée reform and local grievance.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔郡縣保甲與賊鬥死傷者，給錢有差。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: where county baojia fought bandits and suffered death or wound, money was granted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, baojia who died fighting bandits were paid by degree.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復《春秋三傳》明經取士。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Spring and Autumn Three Commentaries classicist subject was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Three Commentaries classicists returned to the examinations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣楚建中等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Chu Jianzhong and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Chu Jianzhong’s mission left for Liao.

sentences.zh: 置洮河安撫司，命王韶主之。

translations.literal: The Tao River pacification office was established; Wang Shao was placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: The Tao River pacification office opened under Wang Shao.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，河決鄆州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingxu: the Yellow River broke at Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingxu: the Yellow River burst at Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大饗明堂，以英宗配。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the great Bright Hall sacrifice was performed with Yingzong as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Bright Hall rites paired Yingzong with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 赦天下，內外官進秩有差。

translations.literal: Amnesty empire-wide; inner and outer officials were advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide amnesty followed; officials were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 庚子，夏人入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Xia envoys presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，增選人奉。

translations.literal: Day guimao: selector stipends were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, lower officials’ salaries were raised.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子朔，罷差役法，使民出錢募役。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renzi, first of month: the corvée law was abolished and the people paid money to hire labor.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renzi new moon: corvée ended; households paid cash to hire service instead.

sentences.zh: 立選人及任子出官試法。

translations.literal: Laws for selectors and hereditary sons entering office by examination were established.
translations.idiomatic: Selectors and hereditary entrants faced new qualifying examinations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，置樞密院檢詳官。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: examining officials were placed in the Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Military Commission gained examining officers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，立太學生內、外、上舍法。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Imperial University inner, outer, and upper-hall law was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the university’s three-tier student system was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔罪人配流，遇冬者至中春乃遣。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: convicts sentenced to exile who met winter were not sent until mid-spring.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, winter exiles were held until mid-spring before dispatch.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午朔，詔凡賞功罰罪，事可懲勸者，月頒之天下。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, first of month, edict: whenever reward and punishment could warn and encourage, monthly bulletins were to circulate empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renwu new moon: exemplary rewards and punishments were to be published monthly.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔蠲逋租。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: overdue rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, back rent was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，作中太一宮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Central Grand Unity Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, work began on the Central Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，開洪澤河達於淮。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Hongze Canal was opened to the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Hongze Canal reached the Huai.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥朔，詔增賜國子監錢四千緡。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai, first of month, edict: the Imperial University grant was increased by four thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinhai new moon: the university budget gained four thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 戊午，歸夏俘。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Xia captives were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Xia prisoners were sent home.

sentences.zh: 己未，安定郡王從式薨。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Prince of Anding Congshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Prince Congshi of Anding died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封越國公世清爲會稽郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Duke of Yue Shi Qing was advanced to Prince of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Duke Shi Qing of Yue became Prince of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，省諸路廂軍。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: garrison troops on the circuits were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, circuit garrison forces were cut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，崇義公柴詠致仕，子若訥襲封。

translations.literal: Duke of Chongyi Chai Yong retired; his son Ruone inherited the fief.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Yong of Chongyi retired and his son Ruone inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遼遣耶律紀等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Liao sent Yelü Ji and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己丑，詔聽降羌歸國。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day jichou, edict: surrendered Qiang were permitted to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, year five, jichou: surrendered Qiang were told they might go home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔太廟時饗，以宗室使相已上攝事。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: at seasonal offerings in the ancestral temple, imperial clansmen of commissioner rank and above were to officiate.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, senior clansmen were to preside at seasonal temple offerings.

sentences.zh: 置京城邏卒，察謗議時政者收罪之。

translations.literal: Capital patrolmen were established to seize those who slandered current policy.
translations.idiomatic: Capital patrols were set to arrest critics of current policy.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，龜茲來貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: Kucha sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renzi: Kucha presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 以兩浙水，賜谷十萬石振之，仍募民興水利。

translations.literal: Because of floods in the two Zhe circuits, one hundred thousand piculs of grain were granted for relief and the people were recruited for waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe floods brought a hundred thousand piculs of relief grain and public waterworks.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔罷陝西遞運銅錫。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: Shaanxi relay transport of copper and tin was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Shaanxi’s relay haul of copper and tin ended.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以知鄭州呂公弼爲宣徽南院使、判秦州，龍圖閣直學士蔡挺爲樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zheng prefect Lü Gongbi became southern bureau palace commissioner and Qinzhou judge; Dragon Hall academician Cai Ting became vice military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Lü Gongbi took Qinzhou and Cai Ting became vice military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，李日尊卒，子乾德嗣，遣使吊贈。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiawu: Li Rizun died; his son Qiande succeeded; envoys were sent to mourn and bestow gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu: Li Rizun died; Qiande succeeded; mourning envoys were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，富弼以司空致仕，進封韓國公。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Fu Bi retired as minister of works and was advanced to Duke of Han.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Fu Bi retired as works minister and became Duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 立文武換官法。

translations.literal: The civil-military exchange-of-office law was established.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials could now exchange career tracks by law.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以內藏庫錢置市易務。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: inner treasury funds established the Market Regulation Office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, palace funds founded the Market Regulation Office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌朔，立殿前馬步軍春秋校試殿最法。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu, first of month: spring and autumn review and ranking of the palace horse and foot army was established.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengxu new moon: the palace army gained spring and autumn competitive reviews.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遼遣耶律適等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Liao sent Yelü Shi and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 己未，括閒田。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: idle fields were surveyed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, idle land was registered.

sentences.zh: 置弓箭手。

translations.literal: Archer-militia were established.
translations.idiomatic: The archer-militia system was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，塞北京決河。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the northern capital’s broken river was sealed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the northern capital’s river breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，詔以古渭砦爲通遠軍，命王韶兼知軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi, edict: Guwei stockade was made Tongyuan army; Wang Shao was also made its prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinsi: Guwei became Tongyuan army under Wang Shao’s command.

sentences.zh: 行教閱法。

translations.literal: The troop-inspection law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The troop-inspection law took effect.

sentences.zh: 宗室非袒免親者許應舉。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen outside the mourning-exempt degree were permitted to take examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Distant clansmen were allowed to sit for the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以青唐大首領俞龍珂爲西頭供奉官，賜姓名包順。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Qingtang great chief Yu Longke was made western-head attendant and given the name Bao Shun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Yu Longke of Qingtang became Bao Shun, western-head attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以趙尚寬等前守唐州辟田疏水有功，增秩以勸天下。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Zhao Shangkuan and others, who had earlier opened fields and dredged water at Tang prefect with merit, were advanced in rank to encourage the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhao Shangkuan and other Tang pioneers were promoted as models for the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 行保馬法。

translations.literal: The horse-purchase law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The horse-purchase law took effect.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，曾公亮乙太傅致仕。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Zeng Gongliang retired as grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renzi: Zeng Gongliang retired as grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以四場試進士。

translations.literal: Day guihai, edict: the four-session examination for presented scholars was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the four-session graduate examination was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，作京城門銅魚符。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: bronze fish tallys were made for the capital gates.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, bronze gate tallies were cast for the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置武學。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Military Academy was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Military Academy opened.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，初以文臣兼樞密都承旨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renyin: for the first time a civil official concurrently held the military commission chief usher post.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin: a civil official first doubled as military commission chief usher.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌，遣中書檢正官章惇察訪荊湖北路。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengxu: Chancellery examining official Zhang Dun was sent to inspect Jinghu North circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, gengxu: Zhang Dun was dispatched to inspect Jinghu North.

sentences.zh: 詔入內供奉官以下，已有養子，更養次子爲內侍者斬。

translations.literal: Edict: inner attendants below palace attendant who already had adopted sons and then adopted a second son as eunuch were to be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs who adopted a second service heir after already having a son faced execution.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，許宗室試換文資。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: imperial clansmen were permitted to test and exchange into civil rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou: clansmen could test into civil office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，始御便殿，旬校諸軍武技。

translations.literal: Day guihai: for the first time he held court in the side hall and every ten days reviewed the armies' martial skills.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, he began side-hall audiences and decennial army drill reviews.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，少華山崩，詔壓死者賜錢，貧者官爲葬祭。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Mount Shaohua collapsed; edict granted cash to those crushed to death, and the poor were to be buried and mourned at official expense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Mount Shaohua fell; crush victims got cash and the poor official burial.

sentences.zh: 淮南分東、西路。

translations.literal: Huainan was divided into eastern and western circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan split into east and west circuits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，升鎮洮軍爲熙州、鎮洮軍節度，置熙河路。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: Zhentao army was raised to Xi Prefecture and Zhentao army command, and the Xi River circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuxu: Zhentao became Xi Prefecture with its own circuit.

sentences.zh: 減秦鳳囚罪一等。

translations.literal: Qin-Feng prisoners' crimes were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: Qin-Feng prisoners won one-grade relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，河州首領瞎藥等來降，以爲內殿崇班，賜姓名包約。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: Hezhou chiefs Xia Yao and others submitted; they were made inner-palace attendants of the honored class and given the surname and name Bao Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guichou: Hezhou chief Xia Yao surrendered as Bao Yue.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，貶權監察御史裏行張商英監荊南稅。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: acting censor trainee Zhang Shangying was demoted to supervise Jingnan tax.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhang Shangying was sent to supervise Jingnan tax.

sentences.zh: 壬申，分陝西爲永興、秦鳳路，仍置六路經略司。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Shaanxi was divided into Yongxing and Qin-Feng circuits, and six-circuit pacification commissions were also established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Shaanxi split into Yongxing and Qin-Feng with six pacification offices.

sentences.zh: 章惇開梅山，置安化縣。

translations.literal: Zhang Dun opened Meishan and established Anhua county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dun opened Meishan and founded Anhua county.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，赦亡命荊湖溪洞者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: fugitives in Jing-Hu stream-cave districts were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingzi: Jing-Hu cave fugitives were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔太原置弓箭手。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: Taiyuan was to establish archer militia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Taiyuan was ordered to raise archer militia.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔寺觀奉聖祖及祖宗陵寢神御者免役錢。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: temples and monasteries serving the sacred ancestor and ancestral tomb spirit images were exempted from corvée money.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, temples with imperial spirit images were freed from corvée levies.

sentences.zh: 改溫成廟爲祠。

translations.literal: Consort Wencheng's shrine was changed to a temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wencheng's shrine became a state temple.

sentences.zh: 壬午，陳升之爲樞密使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Chen Shengzhi was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Chen Shengzhi became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，雨土。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, dust fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 乙未，築熙州南、北關及諸堡砦。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: south and north passes of Xi Prefecture and various stockades were built.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Xi Prefecture's north and south passes and stockades were fortified.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遼遣蕭瑜等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Liao sent Xiao Yu and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛亥，復僖祖爲太廟始祖，以配感生帝。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day xinhai: Ancestor Xi was restored as founding ancestor of the imperial temple, paired with the Lord of Felt Life.
translations.idiomatic: Year six, first month, xinhai: Xi was restored as temple founder, paired with the Felt-Life Lord.

sentences.zh: 祧順祖於夾室。

translations.literal: Ancestor Shun was moved to a side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Shun was relegated to a side chapel.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，夏人寇秦州，都巡檢使劉惟吉敗之。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao: Xia raided Qin Prefecture; chief inspector Liu Weiji defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinmao: Liu Weiji beat back a Xia raid on Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，永昌陵上宮東門火。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: fire at the east gate of the upper palace of Yongchang tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Yongchang tomb's upper palace east gate burned.

sentences.zh: 王韶復河州，獲木征妻子。

translations.literal: Wang Shao recovered He Prefecture and captured Muzheng's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shao retook Hezhou and seized Muzheng's family.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以韓絳知大名府。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Han Jiang was made prefect of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Han Jiang became Daming prefect.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，詔贈熙河死事將田瓊禮賓使，錄其子三人、孫一人。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou, edict: the Xi River officer Tian Qiong, who died in service, was posthumously made ritual envoy; three sons and one grandson were registered for office.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiyou: Tian Qiong of the Xi campaign was posthumously honored and his heirs registered.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，親策進士。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the emperor personally examined presented scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the throne examined graduates in person.

sentences.zh: 置經局，命王安石提舉。

translations.literal: A classics bureau was established; Wang Anshi was ordered to direct it.
translations.idiomatic: A classics bureau was set up under Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，試明經諸科。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the classics and various examination tracks were tested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, classics and specialist examinations were held.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以四月朔日當食，自丁巳避殿、減膳，降天下囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: because the first day of the fourth month would have an eclipse, from dingsi he avoided the main hall and reduced meals; crimes empire-wide were cut one degree and exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, eclipse observances began: reduced meals and empire-wide amnesty below exile.

sentences.zh: 己未，置諸路學官。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: educational officers were established on each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, circuit schoolmasters were appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜奏名進士、諸科及第出身五百九十六人。

translations.literal: Day renxu: five hundred ninety-six presented scholars and specialist graduates were granted jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, 596 graduates received degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲子，交州來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Jiaozhi came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宰相上表請復膳，不許。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the chief ministers memorialized to resume full meals; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the cabinet's plea to end fasting was refused.

sentences.zh: 詔進士、諸科並試明法注官。

translations.literal: Edict: jinshi and specialist graduates were all to test legal statutes for office.
translations.idiomatic: Graduates now had to pass a legal examination for appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置刑獄檢法官。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: penal-case reviewing judges were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, penal review judges were created.

sentences.zh: 庚午，封李日尊子乾德爲交阯郡王。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Li Rizun's son Qiande was enfeoffed Prince of Jiaozhi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Rizun's son Qiande became Prince of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌朔，日食，不見。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu, new moon: solar eclipse, not seen.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiaxu new moon: the eclipse went unseen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day yihai: he resumed full meals at court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, normal court meals resumed.

sentences.zh: 西南龍蕃諸夷來貢。

translations.literal: Southwestern Dragon Fan tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Southwestern Dragon Fan tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 置律學。

translations.literal: A law school was established.
translations.idiomatic: A law school was founded.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遼遣耶律甯等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Liao sent Yelü Ning and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲午，定齊、徐等州保甲。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the baojia militia was fixed for Qi, Xu, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, baojia was organized in Qi, Xu, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，裁定在京吏祿。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: capital officials' salaries were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, capital pay scales were set.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯朔，播州楊貴遷遣子光震來貢，以光震爲三班奉職。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao, new moon: Bozhou's Yang Guixian sent his son Guangzhen to tribute; Guangzhen was made third-rank attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guimao new moon: Yang Guixian of Bozhou sent his son Guangzhen, who received a court rank.

sentences.zh: 戊申，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day wushen: rain prayers were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔京東路察士人有行義者以聞。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: the Jingdong circuit was to seek scholars of moral conduct and report them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Jingdong was told to recommend men of known integrity.

sentences.zh: 遣中書檢正官熊本措置瀘夷。

translations.literal: Secretariat inspection official Xiong Ben was dispatched to manage the Lu barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Ben was sent to handle the Lu tribes.

sentences.zh: 西京左藏庫副使景思忠等攻燒遂州夷囤戰歿，錄其子昌符等七人，軍士死者，賜其家錢帛有差。

translations.literal: Western Capital left treasury deputy commissioner Jing Sizhong and others attacked and burned a Yi stockade at Suizhou and died in battle; his son Changfu and six others were registered; dead soldiers' families received graded cash and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Sizhong died storming a Suizhou Yi stockade; seven heirs were registered and soldiers' kin were compensated.

sentences.zh: 辛未，西南龍蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: southwestern Dragon Fan came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, southwestern Dragon Fan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，置軍器監。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: an armaments directorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jihai: an armaments directorate was created.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，詔京西、淮南、兩浙、江西、荊湖等六路各置鑄錢監。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi, edict: the Jingxi, Huainan, two Zhe, Jiangxi, and Jing-Hu circuits were each to establish coin mints.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yisi: six circuits each gained a coin mint.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大食陀婆離來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Dashi envoy Tuoboli came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Dashi envoy Tuoboli presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: rain prayers were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，錄在京囚，死罪以下降一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: capital prisoners were reviewed; death and below reduced one degree; beating crimes released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, capital prisoners were reviewed and many released.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔沿邊吏殺熟戶以邀賞者戮之。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: frontier officials who killed settled tribesmen to claim rewards were to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, killing settled tribes for bounty became a capital crime.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，分河北爲東、西路。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Hebei was divided into eastern and western circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hebei split into east and west.

sentences.zh: 丙寅夜，西北有聲如磑。

translations.literal: Night of day bingyin: in the northwest a sound like a millstone.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin night the northwest roared like a mill.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔，遣賈昌衡等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen, new moon: Jia Changheng and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renshen new moon: envoys left for Liao's birthday and New Year.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷簡州歲貢綿紬。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Jian Prefecture's annual tribute of floss silk was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Jianzhou's floss-silk tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜熙河、涇原軍士特支錢。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: special cash was granted to Xi River and Jingyuan troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Xi River and Jingyuan soldiers received bonus pay.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復比閭族黨之法。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the law of mutual surveillance among neighbors and kin was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, mutual-responsibility neighborhood law was revived.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，置兩浙和糴倉，立斂散法。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: two-Zhe harmonized-purchase granaries were established and collection-disbursement rules set.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: two-Zhe harmonized-buy granaries opened with fixed rules.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔興水利。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: promote water conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the throne ordered waterworks advanced.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the military examination was conducted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 戊午，岷州首領木令征以其城降，王韶入岷州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Min Prefecture chief Mulingzheng surrendered his city; Wang Shao entered Min Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Mulingzheng surrendered Minzhou to Wang Shao.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白犯鬥。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Venus transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Venus crossed the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔禱雨，決獄。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: pray for rain and decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, rain prayers and prison reviews were ordered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，章惇平懿、洽州蠻。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: Zhang Dun pacified the Yi and Qia prefecture barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinwei: Zhang Dun pacified Yi and Qia barbarians.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以復熙、河、洮、岷、疊、宕等州，御紫宸殿受群臣賀，解所服玉帶賜安石。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: because Xi, He, Tao, Min, Die, and Dang prefectures had been recovered, he received congratulations in the Purple Hall, removed his jade belt, and bestowed it on Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, recovery of the northwestern prefectures brought court congratulations and Anshi received the emperor's belt.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，振兩漸、江、淮饑。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the two Zhe, Yangzi, and Huai regions were relieved from famine.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, southeast famine districts were fed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，行折二錢。

translations.literal: Day renchen: large two-cash coins were put in circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, heavy two-cash coins entered circulation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣使瘞熙河戰骨。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: envoys were sent to bury the Xi River war dead.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, envoys buried Xi River battle dead.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，中太一宮成，減天下囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: the Central Grand Unity Palace was completed; crimes empire-wide were cut one degree and exile and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guichou: the Grand Unity Palace was finished and empire-wide amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，親祀太一宮。

translations.literal: Day yimao: he personally sacrificed at the Grand Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he sacrificed at the Grand Unity Palace in person.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大雪，詔京畿收養老弱凍餒者。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: great snow; edict ordered the capital region to shelter the aged, weak, and frostbitten.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, heavy snow brought orders to shelter the destitute.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，詔決開封府囚。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi, edict: decide Kaifeng prisoners.

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Liao sent Yelü Dong and others to congratulate the new year.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛亥，賞復岷、洮等州功，西京左藏庫使桑湜等遷官有差。

translations.idiomatic: Year seven, first month, xinhai: Min and Tao victors were rewarded; Sang Chen and others were promoted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸中太一宮宴從臣，又幸大相國寺，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he visited the Central Grand Unity Palace and feasted ministers, then visited the Great Xiangguo Monastery and viewed lamps at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封皇子俊爲永國公。

translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Prince Jun became Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 甲子，熊本平瀘夷。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Xiong Ben pacified the Lu barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Xiong Ben pacified the Lu tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，于闐來貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinwei: Khotan came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinwei: Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 發常平米振河陽饑民。

translations.literal: Ever-normal grain was released to feed Henei famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-normal grain fed Henei famine victims.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔三司歲會天下財用出入之數以聞。

translations.literal: Day guiwei, edict: the Three Departments were annually to report empire-wide revenue and expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Three Departments were to report annual finances.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禱雨。

translations.literal: Day yichou: rain prayers were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置客省、引進、四方館、閣門使副等員。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: posts for reception, introduction, four directions, and gate commissioners and vice commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, reception and gate commissioner posts were filled.

sentences.zh: 乙未，知河州景思立等與青宜結鬼章戰于踏白城，敗死。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: He Prefecture prefect Jing Sili and others fought Qingyi chief Guizhang at Tabai stockade and were defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Jing Sili died fighting Guizhang at Tabai stockade.

sentences.zh: 廢遼州。

translations.literal: Liao Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Liaozhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，木征、鬼章寇岷州，高遵裕遣包順等擊走之。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin: Muzheng and Guizhang raided Min Prefecture; Gao Zunyu sent Bao Shun and others to drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin: Gao Zunyu repelled Muzheng and Guizhang from Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 慮囚，減死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Prisoners were reviewed; death crimes reduced one degree; beating and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners were reviewed and many punishments eased.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以旱，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Day guimao: because of drought, he avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, drought brought fasting observances.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day yisi: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使分行諸路，募武士赴熙河。

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, circuit envoys recruited fighters for the Xi River.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔熙河死事者家給錢有差。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: families of Xi River dead were granted graded cash.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Xi River bereaved families received graded payments.

sentences.zh: 罷兩浙增額預置紬絹。

translations.literal: The two-Zhe increased-quota advance silk levy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Two-Zhe advance silk quotas were canceled.

sentences.zh: 令諸路監司察留獄。

translations.literal: Circuit supervisors were ordered to inspect prolonged detention.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors were to check for prolonged imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，群臣表請復膳，不許。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the ministers memorialized to resume full meals; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the cabinet's plea to end fasting was refused.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遼遣林牙蕭禧來言河東疆界，命太常少卿劉忱議之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Liao sent Palisade Xiao Xi to discuss the Hedong border; Vice Director of Rites Liu Chen was ordered to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xiao Xi came on the Hedong border; Liu Chen was to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 己未，行方田法。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the square-fields law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the square-fields law took effect.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣使報聘於遼。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: envoys were sent to return Liao's courtesy visit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, return envoys were sent to Liao.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔以災異求直言。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: because of omens, frank counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, omens brought a call for blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以旱，罷方田。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: because of drought, the square-fields law was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiyou: drought suspended the square-fields law.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 遼遣耶律永甯等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Liao sent Yelü Yongning and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王韶破西蕃於結河川。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Wang Shao defeated western Fan at Jie River.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Shao routed western Fan at Jie River.

sentences.zh: 丙子，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: he resumed full meals at court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, normal court meals resumed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以高遵裕爲岷州團練使。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Gao Zunyu was made training commissioner of Min Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Gao Zunyu became Minzhou training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔邊兵死事無子孫者，廩其親屬終身。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: when frontier soldiers died without descendants, their kin were to receive rations for life.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, kin of childless frontier dead received lifetime rations.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，王韶進築珂諾城，與蕃兵連戰，破之，斬首七千餘級，焚二萬餘帳，木征率酋長八十余人詣軍門降。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Wang Shao advanced to build Kenuo city, fought successive battles with Fan troops, defeated them, beheaded more than seven thousand, burned more than twenty thousand tents; Muzheng led more than eighty chiefs to surrender at headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wang Shao took Kenuo, slew seven thousand Fan, burned twenty thousand tents, and Muzheng surrendered with eighty chiefs.

sentences.zh: 雨雹。

translations.literal: Hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: There was hail.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，王安石罷知江寧府。

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Anshi left Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 置沅州。

translations.literal: Yuan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanzhou was established.

translations.idiomatic: Xiao Su of Liao negotiated the border at Dai Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Hezhou was to bury exposed Fan dead.

translations.literal: Day renyin: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, hail fell.

translations.literal: Day guimao: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, heavy hail fell.

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the eminent and upright and similar examination tracks were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the eminent-and-upright examination was ended.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大雨水，壞陝、平陸二縣。

translations.idiomatic: On yichou, floods wrecked Shaan and Pinglu counties.

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuyin: special cash was granted to troops who attacked Tao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuyin: Tao campaign soldiers received bonus pay.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，作渾儀、浮漏。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: armillary sphere and clepsydra were made.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an armillary sphere and water clock were built.

translations.literal: A phoenix appeared at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou reported a phoenix.

translations.idiomatic: Song Minqiu submitted the revised Gate Protocol.

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, frontier defense was referred to the Military Affairs Bureau.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Han Jiang headed a new fiscal accounting office.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以河北災傷，減州、軍文武官員。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the round altar; empire-wide amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiwei: round-altar sacrifice and empire-wide amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，文武官加恩。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: civil and military officials received favor extensions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, officials received favor promotions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遼遣耶律甯等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Liao sent Yelü Ning and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Liao envoys came for New Year.

translations.idiomatic: Year eight, first month, gengzi: Cai Ting and Feng Jing left their posts.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jingdong split into east and west.

translations.literal: Jiangnan east circuit tribute rice was halted and evenly distributed to disaster prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan east tribute rice went instead to disaster counties.

sentences.zh: 丁未，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: he viewed lamps at Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he watched lamps at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔出使廷臣，所至采吏治能否以聞。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: traveling courtiers were wherever they went to report officials' competence.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, traveling envoys were to report local officials' merit.

sentences.zh: 雨木冰。

translations.literal: Glazed frost fell on trees.
translations.idiomatic: Trees were coated in glazed ice.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔所在流民願歸業者，州縣齎遣之。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: refugees who wished to return home were to be escorted with supplies by prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, willing refugees were sent home with travel funds.

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Tao River pacification office, because of yearly drought, asked to give porridge to feed hungry Qiang households.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Tao River officials sought porridge kitchens for hungry Qiang.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，增陝西錢監改鑄大錢。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Shaanxi coin mints were increased and large coins recast.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiazi: Shaanxi mints cast more large coins.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以王安石同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Wang Anshi was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Anshi joined the council.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔樞密副都承旨張誠一等，以李靖營陣法教殿前馬步軍。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: Associate Military Affairs Reception Chief Zhang Chengyi and others were to teach the palace front horse and foot armies Li Jing's camp formations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Zhang Chengyi taught Li Jing's formations to the palace armies.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，初行河北戶馬法。

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Hebei's household-horse levy began.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，停京畿土功七年。

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, capital construction was paused seven years.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，振潤州饑。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: Run Prefecture famine victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou: Runzhou famine victims were fed.

translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Xianyu Shizhong won a Fan school at Hezhou with land, funds, and extra jinshi slots.

translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Xiao Xi returned; Han Zhen went to Hedong to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，知制誥沈括報聘。

translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Shen Kuo returned from Liao.

sentences.zh: 復振常、潤饑民。

translations.literal: Chang and Run famine victims were relieved again.
translations.idiomatic: Chang and Run were fed again.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，詔減將作監冗官。

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遼遣耶律景熙等來賀同天節。
