translations.literal: Day yihai: Ancestor Xi's combined sacrifice was placed facing east.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xi's combined sacrifice faced east.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吳充爲樞密使。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wu Chong was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wu Chong became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，湖南江水溢。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Hunan River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Hunan River flooded.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，陳升之罷爲鎮江軍節度使、判揚州。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yiwei: Chen Shengzhi was dismissed as Zhenjiang army commissioner and judge of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, yiwei: Chen Shengzhi went to Yangzhou as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廣源州劉紀寇邕州，歸化州儂智會敗之。

translations.literal: Guangyuan Prefecture's Liu Ji raided Yong Prefecture; Guihua Prefecture's Nong Zhihui defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji of Guangyuan raided Yongzhou and Nong Zhihui repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，沈括上《奉元曆》。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Shen Kuo submitted the Fengyuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Shen Kuo presented the Fengyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以宣徽北院使張方平判永興軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Northern Court Privy Councilor Zhang Fangping was made judge of Yongxing army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Fangping judged Yongxing army.

sentences.zh: 分秦鳳路兵爲四將。

translations.literal: Qin-Feng circuit troops were divided into four commands.
translations.idiomatic: Qin-Feng forces were split into four commands.

sentences.zh: 壬子，沂州民朱唐告前余姚縣主簿李逢謀反，辭連右羽林大將軍世居及河中府觀察推官徐革，命御史中丞鄧綰、知諫院範百祿、御史徐禧雜治之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Yizhou commoner Zhu Tang reported former Yuyao county registrar Li Feng's plot to rebel; the testimony implicated Right Feathered Forest general Shiju and Hezhong observation aide Xu Ge; Censor-in-chief Deng Chuo, Remonstrance Bureau director Fan Bailu, and censor Xu Xi were ordered to investigate jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhu Tang accused Li Feng of treason, implicating Shiju and Xu Ge; Deng Chuo, Fan Bailu, and Xu Xi jointly tried the case.

sentences.zh: 獄具，世居賜死，逢、革等伏誅。

translations.literal: When the case was complete, Shiju was granted death; Feng, Ge, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shiju was forced to die; Feng, Ge, and others were executed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，錄趙普後。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: descendants of Zhao Pu were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhao Pu's heirs were registered for office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔西南蕃五姓蠻五年一入貢。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: the five-surname southwestern Fan were to tribute once every five years.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, southwestern five-surname Fan were limited to quinquennial tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉朔，慮囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou, new moon: prisoners were reviewed; death crimes reduced one degree; beating and below released.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou new moon: prisoners were reviewed and many released.

sentences.zh: 甲子，分環慶兵爲四將。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Huanqing troops were divided into four commands.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Huanqing forces split into four commands.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨土及黃毛。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: earth and yellow hair rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, dust and yellow fibers fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲申，熙河路蕃官殿直頓埋謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Xi River circuit Fan officer Palace Attendant Dun Mai plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Dun Mai of the Xi River was executed for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣使振鄜延、環慶饑。

translations.literal: Day jichou: envoys were sent to relieve famine in Zhiyan and Huanqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, envoys fed Zhiyan and Huanqing famine victims.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，虔州江水溢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiazi: the Qianzhou River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiazi: the Qian River flooded.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 戊子，分涇原兵爲五將。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Jingyuan troops were divided into five commands.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jingyuan forces split into five commands.

sentences.zh: 命韓縝如河東割地。

translations.literal: Han Zhen was ordered to cede territory in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen was sent to cede Hedong land.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅朔，日當食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengyin, new moon: an eclipse was due; clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengyin new moon: clouds veiled the expected eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，募民捕蝗易粟，苗損者償之，仍復其賦。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the people were recruited to catch locusts in exchange for grain; where seedlings were damaged compensation was given and tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, locust hunting earned grain and damaged fields were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣謝景溫等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Xie Jingwen and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xie Jingwen and others left for Liao.

sentences.zh: 減官戶役錢之半。

translations.literal: Official households' corvée money was halved.
translations.idiomatic: Official households' corvée payments were cut in half.

sentences.zh: 詔發運司體實淮南、江東、兩浙米價，州縣所存上供米毋過百萬石，減直予民，鬥錢勿過八十。

translations.literal: Edict: the transport office was to verify rice prices in Huainan, Jiangdong, and two-Zhe; stored tribute rice in prefectures and counties was not to exceed one million bushels; grain was sold cheap to the people at no more than eighty cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Transport officials capped stored tribute rice and sold surplus cheap—no more than eighty cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，韓絳罷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Han Jiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Han Jiang left office.

sentences.zh: 發河北、京東兵及監牧卒修都城。

translations.literal: Hebei and Jingdong troops and pasture-guard conscripts were mobilized to repair the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei, Jingdong, and pasture guards repaired the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大閱。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the armies held a grand review.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，王安石兼修國史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen, new moon: Wang Anshi was additionally made overseer of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengshen new moon: Wang Anshi also took charge of the national history.

sentences.zh: 立武舉絕倫法。

translations.literal: The peerless-excellence law for military examinations was established.
translations.idiomatic: A peerless-excellence track was added to the military exams.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，呂惠卿罷知陳州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengyin: Lü Huiqing was dismissed as prefect of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengyin: Lü Huiqing left Chenzhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，彗出軫。

translations.literal: Day yimao: a comet appeared in the Chariot constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a comet rose in the Chariot.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔以災異數見，不御前殿，減常膳，求直言。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: because omens and disasters had repeatedly appeared, the emperor would not hold court in the front hall, reduced his regular meals, and sought forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, repeated omens brought austerity—no front-hall audiences, simpler meals, and a call for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an empire-wide amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 罷手實法。

translations.literal: The crop-reporting law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The crop-reporting law ended.

sentences.zh: 丁未，彗不見。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the comet was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the comet vanished.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the emperor resumed audiences in the hall and his regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, court and regular meals resumed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，交阯陷欽州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: Jiaozhi captured Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuyin: Jiaozhi took Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，立陝西蕃丁法。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Shaanxi tribal militia law was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Shaanxi tribal militia law was enacted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，交阯陷廉州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Jiaozhi captured Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Jiaozhi took Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，渝州改南平軍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Yuzhou was changed to Nanping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yuzhou became Nanping commandery.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，浚河。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen: rivers were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingshen: rivers were dredged.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以翰林學士元絳參知政事，龍圖閣直學士曾孝寬簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Hanlin academician Yuan Jiang was made participating administrator; Dragon Hall academician Zeng Xiaokuan was made deputy military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Yuan Jiang joined the council and Zeng Xiaokuan the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，天章閣待制趙禼爲安南道招討使，嘉州防禦使李憲副之，以討交阯。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Tianzhang Hall attendant Zhao Xi was made pacification commissioner for the An Nam circuit, with Jiazhou defender Li Xian as deputy, to campaign against Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhao Xi led the An Nam campaign with Li Xian as deputy against Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遼遣耶律世通等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Liao sent Yelü Shitong and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yelü Shitong arrived from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，熙河路木宗城首領結彪謀叛，熟羌日腳族青廝扒斬其首來獻，補下班殿侍。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Muzong City chief Jie Biao of the Xihé circuit plotted rebellion; the mature-Qiang Rijiao tribe’s Qingsibai beheaded him and presented the head, and was appointed a lower-rank palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Qingsibai of the Rijiao Qiang killed rebel chief Jie Biao and received a palace attendant post.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙丑，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Year nine, spring, first month, day yichou: trees bore ice.
translations.idiomatic: Year 9, first month, yichou: glaze ice coated the trees.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，交阯陷邕州，知州蘇緘死之。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Jiaozhi captured Yongzhou; prefect Su Jian died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yongzhou fell; Su Jian was killed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，下溪州刺史彭師晏及天賜州降。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Lower Stream prefect Peng Shiyan and Tiansi prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Peng Shiyan of Lower Stream and Tiansi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使祭南嶽、南海，告以南伐。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Southern Marchmount and the Southern Sea, announcing the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, envoys sacrificed at the Southern Marchmount and Sea to proclaim the southern war.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，贈蘇緘奉國軍節度使，諡忠勇，以其子子元爲西頭供奉官、閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Su Jian was posthumously made military commissioner of Fengguo with the posthumous title Loyal and Brave; his son Ziyuan was made a western-head palace attendant and gate usher.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Su Jian was ennobled Loyal and Brave posthumously; his son Ziyuan entered palace service.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，宣徽南院使郭逵爲安南道招討使，罷李憲，以趙禼副之。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: Southern Court commissioner Guo Kui was made An Nam pacification commissioner; Li Xian was removed and Zhao Xi made deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuzi: Guo Kui replaced Li Xian; Zhao Xi became his deputy on the An Nam front.

sentences.zh: 詔占城、占臘合擊交阯。

translations.literal: Edict: Champa and Zhanla were to strike Jiaozhi jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Champa and Zhanla were ordered to join the attack on Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宗哥首領鬼章寇五牟穀，蕃官藺氈訥支等邀擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Zongge chief Gui Zhang raided Wumugu Valley; tribal officer Lan Zhannezhi and others ambushed and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Gui Zhang raided Wumugu; Lan Zhannezhi ambushed and shattered his force.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以出師，罷春宴。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because troops were marching out, the spring banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the spring banquet was canceled for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day yimao: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 三月內辰朔，進仁宗婉容周氏爲妃。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen new moon: Renzong’s attendant Lady Zhou was advanced to consort.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingchen new moon: Lady Zhou of Renzong’s household became consort.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the emperor held the palace examination for advanced scholars in the Hall of Assembled Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the palace examination was held in the Hall of Assembled Excellence.

sentences.zh: 恤欽、廉、邕三州死事家，瘞戰亡士，賊所蹂踐，除其田征。

translations.literal: The families of those who died in Qin, Lian, and Yong prefectures were comforted; fallen soldiers were buried; where the enemy had trampled fields, land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Qin, Lian, and Yong mourning families were aided, the dead buried, and trampled fields tax-free.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜進士、諸科及第出身五百九十六人。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: five hundred ninety-six men received advanced-scholar and specialist degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, five hundred ninety-six men took degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以廣西進士徐伯祥爲右侍禁、欽廉白州巡檢。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Guangxi advanced scholar Xu Boxiang was made right palace guard and inspector of Qin, Lian, and Baizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xu Boxiang of Guangxi became inspector of Qin, Lian, and Baizhou.

sentences.zh: 宗哥首領鬼章寇五牟穀，熙河鈐轄韓存寶敗之。

translations.literal: Zongge chief Gui Zhang again raided Wumugu Valley; Xihé controller Han Cunbao defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Zhang raided Wumugu again; Han Cunbao beat him back.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以種諤知岷州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Zhong E was made prefect of Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zhong E became Minzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，遼遣耶律庶幾等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinmao: Liao sent Yelü Shuji and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinmao: Yelü Shuji came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以遼主母喪，罷同天節上壽。

translations.literal: Day yimao: because the Liao empress dowager was in mourning, the birthday felicitation for Shared Heaven was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liao mourning canceled the Shared Heaven birthday rites.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復廣濟河漕。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: transport on the Guangji Canal was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Guangji Canal shipping resumed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔廣南亡沒士卒及百姓爲賊殘破者，轉運、安撫司具實，並議振恤以聞。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: where Guangnan soldiers and commoners had been lost or ravaged by the enemy, transport and pacification offices were to verify facts and report plans for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Guangnan offices were to verify war losses and propose relief.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，給空名告身付安南，以招降賞功。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: blank commission scrolls were issued to An Nam to recruit surrenders and reward merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, blank commissions went to An Nam for rewards and surrenders.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路募武勇赴廣西。

translations.literal: Edict: each circuit was to recruit martial men for Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit was told to send fighting men to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 贈廣西死事將士官有差。

translations.literal: Officers and generals who died in Guangxi were posthumously ennobled in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi’s fallen officers received graded posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣王克臣等吊慰於遼。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wang Keichen and others were sent to offer Liao condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Keichen led the Liao condolence mission.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，茂州夷寇邊，遣內侍押班王中正經制。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Maozhou tribes raided the border; inner attendant Wang Zhongzheng was sent to take overall command.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Maozhou tribes raided; Wang Zhongzheng took command.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遼遣耶律孝淳以國母喪來告，帝發哀成服，輟視朝七日。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Liao sent Yelü Xiaochun to announce the empress dowager’s death; the emperor put on mourning and suspended audiences for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yelü Xiaochun announced Liao mourning; the court mourned seven days without audience.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，詔邕州沿邊州峒首領來降者，周惠之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen new moon, edict: chieftains along Yongzhou’s border who came to surrender were to be treated with full kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen new moon: surrendering Yongzhou border chiefs were promised full kindness.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔試醫學生。

translations.literal: Day guihai: medical students were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, medical students faced examination.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，分兩浙爲東、西路。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the two Zhe circuits were divided into east and west.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhe was split into eastern and western circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，城茂州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Maozhou was walled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Maozhou was fortified.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔安南諸軍過嶺有疾者，所至護治。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: An Nam forces crossing the ranges with illness were to be cared for wherever they halted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, sick An Nam troops were to be treated at every halt across the ranges.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大理國來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Dali sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Dali presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，靜州下首領董整白等來降。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: chieftains Dong Zhengbai and others of lower Jingzhou came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Dong Zhengbai and other Jingzhou chiefs surrendered.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，詔安南將吏，視軍士有疾者月以數聞。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai, edict: An Nam commanders and clerks were to report monthly the number of ill soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dinghai: An Nam officers were to report sick rolls monthly.

sentences.zh: 己丑，綿州都監王慶、崔昭用、劉珪、左侍禁張乂援戰茂州，死之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Mianzhou controller Wang Qing, Cui Zhaoyong, Liu Gui, and left palace guard Zhang Yiyuan fought at Maozhou and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Qing, Cui Zhaoyong, Liu Gui, and Zhang Yiyuan fell at Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 詔慶等子與借職，女出嫁，夫與奉職；

translations.literal: Edict: sons of Qing and the others received provisional rank; daughters upon marriage, their husbands received palace rank.
translations.idiomatic: Their sons gained provisional rank; sons-in-law of their daughters gained palace rank.

sentences.zh: 白丁王禹錫等二人，賜錢其家。

translations.literal: Commoners Wang Yuxi and two others were given money for their families.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yuxi and two other commoners’ families received cash.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔濱海富民得養蜑戶，毋致爲外夷所誘。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: wealthy coastal households might keep Dan households in service, but must not let them be enticed by foreign tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, coastal magnates could keep Dan boat people—but not lose them to foreigners.

sentences.zh: 己亥，慮囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jihai: prisoners were reviewed; death sentences were reduced one grade, and those liable to beating or flogging were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, death sentences dropped a grade and lesser punishments were cleared.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以水源等洞蠻主儂賀等七人爲定遠、甯遠將軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: seven cave chiefs including Nong He of the Shuiyuan district were made generals of Dingyuan and Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Nong He and six other cave chiefs became Dingyuan and Ningyuan generals.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，朱崖軍黎賊黃嬰入寇，詔廣南西路嚴兵備之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: Li bandit Huang Ying of Zhuyai commandery raided; the Guangnan West circuit was ordered to ready troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingchen: Huang Ying of Zhuyai raided; Guangnan West armed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，關以西蝗蝻、虸蚄生。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: locusts and plant lice appeared west of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, locusts and lice swarmed west of the passes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，築下溪州，改名會溪城。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Lower Stream prefecture was built and renamed Huixi city.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Lower Stream was rebuilt as Huixi city.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，靜州將楊文緒結蕃部謀叛，王中正斬之以徇。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Jingzhou officer Yang Wenxu plotted rebellion with tribal allies; Wang Zhongzheng beheaded him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wang Zhongzheng executed rebel officer Yang Wenxu.

sentences.zh: 詔廣西死事官無子孫者許立後。

translations.literal: Edict: Guangxi officers who died without sons or grandsons might have heirs established.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi officers without heirs could have successors named by law.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔自今遇大禮推恩，官昭憲太后族一人。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: from now on, at each great-ceremony grace enfeoffment, one man of Empress Dowager Zhaoxian’s clan was to receive office.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, great-ceremony grace would ennoble one Zhaoxian clansman.

sentences.zh: 是月，安南行營次桂州，郭逵遣鈐轄和斌等督水軍涉海自廣東入，諸軍自廣南入。

translations.literal: That month the An Nam field headquarters halted at Guizhou; Guo Kui sent controller He Bin and others to lead the navy by sea from Guangdong while the rest entered by Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: That month the An Nam army paused at Guizhou; He Bin’s fleet sailed from Guangdong while the rest marched from Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申朔，齊州監務左班殿直孫紀死賊，錄其一子爲三班借職。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen new moon: Qizhou transport clerk Sun Ji died fighting bandits; one son was recorded as provisional third-rank agent.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiashen new moon: Sun Ji of Qizhou fell; a son gained provisional third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以文彥博守太保兼待中，行太原尹。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wen Yanbo was made guardian grand master and chief councilor, acting as Taiyuan intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wen Yanbo became guardian grand master and acting Taiyuan intendant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣程師孟等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Cheng Shiming and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Cheng Shiming led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.

sentences.zh: 罷鬻祠廟錢。

translations.literal: The sale of temple endowment funds was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Temple endowment sales ended.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁北邊民闌出穀粟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: northern-border commoners were forbidden to smuggle grain out.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, northern peasants were barred from exporting grain.

sentences.zh: 庚子，占城來貢。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Champa presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，浚汴河。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: the Bian Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: the Bian Canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔罷都大制置河北河防水利司。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the grand commissioner for Hebei rivers and waterworks was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Hebei river grand commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遼遣使回謝。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Liao sent envoys to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Liao envoys returned thanks.

sentences.zh: 詔恤嶺南死事家，表將士墓。

translations.literal: Edict: families of the dead in Lingnan were comforted and officers’ graves marked.
translations.idiomatic: Lingnan mourning families were aided and officers’ graves honored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiyou: Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiyou: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔東南諸路教閱新軍。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: southeastern circuits were to drill the new armies.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the southeast was ordered to drill its new troops.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王安石罷判江寧府。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wang Anshi was dismissed as acting Jiangning prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Anshi left Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 以吳充監修國史，王珪爲集賢殿大學士，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wu Chong was made overseer of the national history; Wang Gui was made grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, both co-equal with the emperor at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chong took the history; Wang Gui joined the council as co-equal minister.

sentences.zh: 資政殿學士馮京知樞密院。

translations.literal: Policy-council academician Feng Jing was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Jing became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，除放沅州歸明人戶去年倚閣秋稅。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: last year’s deferred autumn tax for surrendered households of Yuanzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Yuanzhou’s surrendered households were freed of deferred autumn tax.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，賜廣南東路空名告敕，募入錢助軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yimao: blank commissions were granted to the Guangnan East circuit to recruit cash contributions for the army.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yimao: Guangnan East got blank commissions to raise war funds.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄唐相魏征後同州司士參軍道嚴，流內銓特免試注官。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wei Zheng’s Tang descendant Dao Yan, a Tongzhou clerk, was entered in the inner personnel roster with exemption from examination for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wei Zheng’s descendant Dao Yan skipped the civil-service exam.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以安南行營將士疾疫，遣同知太常禮院王存禱南嶽，遣中使建祈福道場。

translations.literal: Day yihai: because the An Nam army suffered plague, Wang Cun of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was sent to pray at the Southern Marchmount, and inner attendants built blessing altars.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, plague in An Nam sent Wang Cun to pray at the Southern Marchmount.

sentences.zh: 己卯，洮東安撫司言包順等破鬼章兵于多移穀。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Tao East pacification office reported Bao Shun and others had broken Gui Zhang’s force at Duoyigu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Bao Shun routed Gui Zhang at Duoyigu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鬼章寇岷州，知州種諤等敗之鐵城。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Gui Zhang raided Minzhou; prefect Zhong E and others defeated him at Iron City.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhong E beat Gui Zhang at Iron City.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，安南偽觀察使劉紀降。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: Liu Ji, Jiaozhi’s false observation commissioner, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingxu: Jiaozhi’s Liu Ji surrendered.

sentences.zh: 置司農丞。

translations.literal: A Ministry of Revenue vice-director post was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Ministry of Revenue vice-director was added.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，子傭生。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the prince Zi Yong was born.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Prince Zi Yong was born.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔岷州界經鬼章兵燹者賜錢，脅從來歸者釋其罪。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: where Minzhou’s border had suffered Gui Zhang’s ravages, money was granted; those coerced who returned were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, ravaged Minzhou got cash; coerced returners were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，郭逵敗交阯于富良江，獲其偽太子洪真，李乾德遣人奉表詣軍門降，逵遂班師。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Guo Kui defeated Jiaozhi at the Fu River, captured the false crown prince Hong Zhen; Li Qianfu sent envoys with a surrender petition to the camp, and Kui withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Guo Kui crushed Jiaozhi at the Fu River, took Hong Zhen, and withdrew after Li Qianfu’s surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遼遣耶律運等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Liao sent Yelü Yun and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yelü Yun came from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔有得鬼章、冷雞樸首者，賞之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, edict: whoever captured Gui Zhang or Lengjipu was to be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, bounties were set for Gui Zhang or Lengjipu.

sentences.zh: 置威戎軍。

translations.literal: Weirong commandery was established.
translations.idiomatic: Weirong commandery was created.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月乙丑，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Year ten, spring, first month, day yichou: the emperor viewed lanterns at Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Year 10, first month, yichou: lanterns were viewed at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，仙韶院火，不視朝。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Immortal Harmonies courtyard burned; the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Immortal Harmonies burned and court was canceled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，白虹貫日二月甲申，以崇信軍節度使宗旦同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jisi: a white rainbow spanned the sun. Second month, day jiashen: Chongxin military commissioner Zong Dan was made co-equal with the emperor at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, a white rainbow crossed the sun. Second month, jiashen: Zong Dan joined the council.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以鬼章敗，種諤等賞官有差。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: because Gui Zhang was defeated, Zhong E and others received graded promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhong E and others were rewarded for beating Gui Zhang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔宗室使相雖及十年，更不取旨磨勘。

translations.literal: Day jiawu, edict: imperial clansmen who were envoys or co-equal ministers, even after ten years, no longer needed imperial approval for merit review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, senior imperial clansmen skipped imperial sign-off on merit review.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔諸州歲以十一月給老疾貧乏者粟，盡三月乃止。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: each prefecture yearly in the eleventh month was to issue grain to the aged, ill, and poor until the third month.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, prefectures were to feed the aged, sick, and poor each winter through spring.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以王韶知洪州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wang Shao was made prefect of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Shao became Hongzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以復廣源、蘇茂等州，群臣表賀，赦廣州囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: because Guangyuan, Sumao, and other prefectures were recovered, ministers congratulated; Guangzhou prisoners were pardoned one grade, and those liable to penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, recovered prefectures brought congratulations and a Guangzhou prison pardon.

sentences.zh: 賜行營諸軍錢，民緣征役者恤其家。

translations.literal: The field army was given money; families of people pressed into service were comforted.
translations.idiomatic: The army was paid; conscript families were aided.

sentences.zh: 以廣源州爲順州，赦李乾德罪。

translations.literal: Guangyuan prefecture was made Shun prefecture; Li Qianfu’s crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan became Shun prefecture; Li Qianfu was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以郭逵判潭州，趙禼知桂州。

translations.literal: Guo Kui was made acting prefect of Tanzhou; Zhao Xi was made prefect of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Kui took Tanzhou; Zhao Xi took Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以交阯降，赦廣南東路、荊湖南路系囚，餘各降一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: because Jiaozhi surrendered, prisoners in Guangnan East and Jinghu South were pardoned; the rest were reduced one grade, and those liable to penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Jiaozhi’s surrender brought pardons in Guangnan East and Jinghu South.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，慮囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: prisoners were reviewed; death sentences were reduced one grade, and those liable to beating or flogging were released.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinwei: death sentences dropped a grade and lesser punishments cleared.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔州縣捕蝗。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: prefectures and counties were to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, locust-hunting was ordered in every county.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，復置憲州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi: Xian prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinsi: Xianzhou was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遼遣蕭儀等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Liao sent Xiao Yi and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xiao Yi came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，文州蕃賊寇邊，州兵擊走之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Wenzhou tribal bandits raided the border; local troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wenzhou tribes raided and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜熙河路兵特支錢，戰死者賜帛，免夏秋稅。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Xihé troops received special pay; the fallen were given silk, and spring and autumn taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Xihé soldiers got bonus pay, silk for the dead, and tax relief.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，詔修仁宗、英宗史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuwu, edict: the histories of Renzong and Yingzong were to be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuwu: compilation of Renzong’s and Yingzong’s histories was ordered.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，注輦國朝貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: the Chola state sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renwu: Chola sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，王安石以使相爲集禧觀使。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Wang Anshi, as envoy-minister, became commissioner of the Jixi Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wang Anshi left politics for the Jixi Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丁未，置岷州鐵城堡。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Iron City fort in Minzhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Iron City fort was built in Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，禱雨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiayin: the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，令諸路歲上縣令課績。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: each circuit yearly was to report magistrates’ performance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, circuits were to file annual magistrate ratings.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，群臣五上尊號曰奉天憲古文武仁孝皇帝，不許。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the ministers five times offered the honorific “Emperor who receives Heaven, reveres antiquity, and is civil, martial, and filial”; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, five honorific titles were refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，郭逵以安南失律，貶爲左衛將軍。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Guo Kui, for misconduct in An Nam, was demoted to left guard general.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Guo Kui was demoted for An Nam misconduct.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河決澶州曹村埽。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Yellow River breached at Cao Village embankment in Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Yellow River broke Cao Village levee in Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，詔潭州置將及增武臣一員。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin, edict: Tanzhou was to have a general appointed and one more military officer added.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: Tanzhou gained a general and an extra military officer.

sentences.zh: 遣蘇頌等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Su Song and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Su Song led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔侍從、台諫、監司各舉文臣有才行者一人。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: attendants, remonstrators, and circuit commissioners each were to recommend one civil official of talent and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, each senior office was to name one able civil official.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，詔：「河決害民田，所屬州縣疏瀹，仍蠲其稅，老幼疾病者振之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu, edict: “Where the river breaches harms people’s fields, the prefecture and county concerned shall dredge and clear; still remit their taxes, and relief those who are aged, young, or ill.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengxu: flooded counties were to dredge, remit tax, and aid the aged, young, and sick.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，詔：「諸傳宣、內批、面諭，事無法守，並從中書、樞密覆奏。

translations.literal: ” Day yimao, edict: “All relayed announcements, inner drafts, and face-to-face orders for which there is no statute to uphold shall all be reported back through the Secretariat and Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, unstatuted palace orders had to pass Secretariat and Military Affairs review.

sentences.zh: 其祈恩澤規免罪者劾之。

translations.literal: Those who seek grace or scheme to escape punishment shall be impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Petitioners scheming to escape punishment were to be impeached.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，詔鎮戎、德順軍各置都監一員。

translations.literal: ” Day xinyou, edict: Zhenrong and Deshun armies each were to have one inspector post added.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhenrong and Deshun each gained an inspector.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，立義倉。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the charity-granary system was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the charity-granary system was founded.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宗樸兼侍中，封濮陽郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zong Pu was made concurrent chief councilor and enfeoffed as prince of Puyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zong Pu became prince of Puyang and joined the council.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，宗樸薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin new moon: Zong Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuyin new moon: Zong Pu died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，昭化軍節度使宗誼封濮國公。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zhaohua military commissioner Zong Yi was enfeoffed as prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zong Yi became prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 詔濮王子以次襲封奉祀。

translations.literal: Edict: Pu princes’ sons in order were to inherit the fief for ancestral rites.
translations.idiomatic: Pu princes’ sons would inherit in turn for ancestral worship.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太子太師張昪卒。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Grand mentor Zhang Bian died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Grand Mentor Zhang Bian died.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，以西蕃邈川首領董氈、都首領青宜結鬼章爲廓州刺史，阿令骨爲松州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu: western tribes’ Miaochuan chief Dong Zhan and supreme chief Gui Zhang Qingyijie were made prefects of Kuo; Alinggu was made prefect of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengwu: Dong Zhan and Gui Zhang became Kuo prefects; Alinggu took Song.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祀天地於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the round altar; an empire-wide amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the round-altar sacrifice brought a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑朔，占城國獻馴象。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou new moon: Champa presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingchou new moon: Champa sent tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔改明年爲元豐。

translations.literal: Day renwu, edict: the coming year was to be styled Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the next reign era was named Yuanfeng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以郊祀，文武官加恩。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because of the suburban sacrifice, civil and military officials received grace promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, suburban sacrifice brought grace promotions.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封子傭爲均國公。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Zi Yong was enfeoffed as prince of Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zi Yong became prince of Jun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遼遣耶律孝淳等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Liao sent Yelü Xiaochun and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Yelü Xiaochun came from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，以翰林侍讀學士、寶文閣學士、提點中太一宮呂公著兼端明殿學士。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinsi: Hanlin reader Lü Gongzhu, Baowen Hall academician and commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace, was made concurrent academician of the Duanming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, xinsi: Lü Gongzhu gained the Duanming Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔贈尚書令韓琦依趙普故事。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: posthumous enfeoffment of Han Qi as chief councilor was to follow Zhao Pu’s precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Han Qi’s posthumous honors followed Zhao Pu’s precedent.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，樞密直學士孫固同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Military Affairs academician Sun Gu was made deputy military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Sun Gu joined the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太傅兼侍中曾公亮薨。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Grand preceptor and chief councilor Zeng Gongliang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zeng Gongliang died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, a sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以公亮配饗英宗廟庭。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Gongliang was given a place in Yingzong’s temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Gongliang entered Yingzong’s temple.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，濮國公宗誼薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu: Prince of Pu Zong Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengxu: Prince of Pu Zong Yi died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以邕州觀察使宗暉爲淮康軍節度使，封濮國公。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yongzhou observation commissioner Zong Hui was made Huaiang military commissioner and enfeoffed as prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zong Hui became prince of Pu and Huaiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔赦安南戰棹都監楊從先等，仍論功行賞。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: An Nam war-boat controller Yang Congxian and others were pardoned and still rewarded according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yang Congxian and other An Nam officers were pardoned and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，慮囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: prisoners were reviewed; death sentences were reduced one grade, and those liable to beating or flogging were released.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinsi: death sentences dropped a grade and lesser punishments cleared.

sentences.zh: 御邇英閣，沈季長進講《周禮》八法。

translations.literal: At the Neared Excellence Hall, Shen Jichang lectured on the Eight Methods of the Rites of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: At Neared Excellence, Shen Jichang lectured on the Zhou Rites’ Eight Methods.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔內外文武官各舉堪應武舉一人。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: civil and military officials inside and outside each were to recommend one man fit for the military examination.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, every office was to name one candidate for the military exam.

sentences.zh: 廣南西路經略司乞教閱峒丁，從之。

translations.literal: The Guangnan West pacification office asked to drill cave militia; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan West was allowed to drill its cave militia.

sentences.zh: 乙未，御崇政殿閱諸軍。

translations.literal: Day yimao: at the Hall of Esteemed Governance the emperor reviewed the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the emperor reviewed troops at Esteemed Governance.

sentences.zh: 辰、沅徭賊寇邊，州兵擊走之。

translations.literal: Chen and Yuan Yao bandits raided the border; local troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Chen and Yuan Yao raiders were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，遼遣耶律永甯等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou: Liao sent Yelü Yongning and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiyou: Yelü Yongning came from Liao for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔增置兩浙路提舉官。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: additional supervisory posts were established on the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the two Zhe circuits gained more supervisors.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔除《九經》外，餘書不得出界。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: except for the Nine Classics, no other books might be taken beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, only the Nine Classics could cross the frontier.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，封虢國公宗諤爲豫章郡王。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Prince of Guo Zong E was enfeoffed as prince of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zong E became prince of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，塞曹村決河，名其埽曰靈平。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Cao Village breach was closed; the embankment was named Lingping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Cao Village levee was sealed and named Lingping.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，賜塞河役死家錢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu new moon: families of those who died in the river work were given money.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiaxu new moon: river-work dead were compensated.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔試中刑法官以次推恩。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: those who passed the penal-law examination were to receive grace promotions in order.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, penal-law examinees gained graded promotions.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔以靈平功遷太常博士苗師中等各一官。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: because of the Lingping achievement, Court of Sacrifices doctor Miao Shizhong and others each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Miao Shizhong and others were promoted for sealing Lingping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉朔，命西上閣門使、忠州團練使韓存寶經制瀘州納溪夷。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou new moon: western-upper gate envoy and Chongzhou regimentation commissioner Han Cunbao was ordered to take overall command against the Naxi tribes of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiyou new moon: Han Cunbao took command against Luzhou’s Naxi.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔齊州預備水災。

translations.literal: Day jihai, edict: Qizhou was to prepare against flood.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Qizhou was told to ready for flood.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夔州言甘露降。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Kuizhou reported sweet dew had fallen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Kuizhou reported sweet dew.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，西邊將訥兒溫、祿尊謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: western generals Nai’erwen and Luzun plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guimao: Nai’erwen and Luzun were executed for treason.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔河北被水者蠲其租。

translations.literal: Day dingwei, edict: Hebei flood victims had rent remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Hebei flood victims were tax-free.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣黃履等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Huang Lü and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Huang Lü led the Liao birthday and New Year mission.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以韓絳爲建雄軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Han Jiang was made Jianxiong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Han Jiang became Jianxiong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔濱、棣、滄三州被水民以常平糧貸之。

translations.literal: Day jisi, edict: flood victims of Bin, Di, and Cang prefectures were lent grain from the Ever-Normal granary.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Bin, Di, and Cang flood victims got Ever-Normal loans.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔青、齊、淄三州給流民食。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: Qing, Qi, and Zi prefectures were to feed displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Qing, Qi, and Zi fed the displaced.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，交阯來貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Jiaozhi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiyou: Jiaozhi presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李乾德表乞還廣源等州，詔不許。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Li Qianfu memorialized asking return of Guangyuan and other prefectures; the edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Qianfu’s plea to recover Guangyuan was denied.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以端明殿學士呂公著、樞密直學士薛向並同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Duanming Hall academician Lü Gongzhu and Military Affairs academician Xue Xiang were both made deputy military affairs commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Lü Gongzhu and Xue Xiang joined the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 詔祀天地及配帝並用特牲。

translations.literal: Edict: sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and the accompanying deities all used special victims.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-and-Earth rites were to use special victims throughout.

sentences.zh: 是月，武康軍嘉禾生，河中府甘露降。

translations.literal: That month: Wukang commandery bore fine grain; Hezhong prefecture reported sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wukang’s fine grain and Hezhong’s sweet dew were reported.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，定秋試諸軍賞格。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: the autumn army-examination reward scale was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengxu: autumn army-exam rewards were standardized.

sentences.zh: 侍禁仵全死事，錄其弟宣爲三班借職。

translations.literal: Palace guard Wu Quan died in service; his younger brother Xuan was recorded as provisional third-rank agent.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Quan fell in service; his brother Xuan gained provisional third rank.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，韓存寶破瀘夷後城十有三囤。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Han Cunbao broke the Lu tribes and afterward walled thirteen stockades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Han Cunbao crushed the Lu tribes and walled thirteen forts.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，于闐來貢。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Khotan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Khotan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，命龍圖閣直學士宋敏求等詳定正旦御殿儀注。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jichou: Dragon Hall academician Song Minqiu and others were ordered to fix the New Year audience ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jichou: Song Minqiu was to fix New Year audience rites.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，辰州徭賊叛，詔沅州兵討之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Chenzhou Yao bandits rebelled; Yuanzhou troops were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Chenzhou Yao rebelled; Yuanzhou troops were sent.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷文武功臣號。

translations.literal: Day yihai: civil and military merit titles were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, civil and military merit titles ended.

sentences.zh: 是月，梁縣嘉禾生。

translations.literal: That month: Liang county bore fine grain.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liang county reported fine grain.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，日中有黑子，凡十二日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu: a black spot appeared in the sun for twelve days.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingwu: a sunspot lasted twelve days.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錄囚，降死罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: prisoners were recorded; death sentences were reduced one grade, and those liable to beating or flogging were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, death sentences dropped a grade and lesser punishments cleared.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔青州民王贇以復父仇免死，刺配鄰州。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: Qingzhou commoner Wang Yun, for avenging his father, was spared death but tattooed and banished to a neighboring prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Wang Yun was spared for patricide revenge but banished and tattooed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，置大理寺獄。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: a prison was established at the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Judicial Review court gained its own prison.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔罷都大提舉在京諸司庫務司。

translations.literal: Day jiwei, edict: the grand commissioner for capital storehouses was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the capital storehouse grand commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以婉容邢氏爲賢妃。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: attendant Lady Xing was advanced to honored consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lady Xing became honored consort.

sentences.zh: 詔罷三司推勘公事官，減軍器監勾當公事，審官東院、流內銓及將作監、三班院主簿，左右軍巡判官。

translations.literal: Edict: the Three Departments investigation officer, the Armory Directorate clerk, Eastern Personnel Review, inner personnel roster, Construction Directorate, third-rank bureau clerks, and left and right military patrol judges were abolished or reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Investigation, armory, personnel, construction, and patrol posts were cut across the capital bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遼遣耶律隆等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Liao sent Yelü Long and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yelü Long came from Liao for New Year.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥，罷岢嵐、火山軍市馬。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day yihai: horse markets at Kelan and Huoshan armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Year 2, first month, yihai: Kelan and Huoshan horse markets closed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔立高麗交易法。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, edict: trade regulations with Goryeo were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Goryeo trade rules were enacted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以容州管內觀察使、上柱國、南陽郡開國公楊遂爲甯遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Rong prefecture circuit observer, pillar of state, Duke of Nanyang Yang Sui was made Ningyuan army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yang Sui of Rongzhou was appointed Ningyuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔知沅州謝麟督捕徭賊。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: Yuan prefecture prefect Xie Lin was to supervise the hunt for Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Xie Lin of Yuanzhou was ordered to hunt Yao rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲申，御宣德門觀燈。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: he viewed lanterns at the Xuande Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he watched lantern displays at Xuande Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以經義、論試宗室。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: imperial clansmen were to be examined by classical exegesis and discourse.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, clansmen were tested on classical exegesis and policy essays.

sentences.zh: 甲午，京兆府學教授蔣夔乞以十哲從祀孔子，從之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Capital prefecture school instructor Jiang Kui asked that the Ten Sages join Confucius in sacrifice; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Jiang Kui won approval to add the Ten Sages to Confucian sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 詔辰州敘浦縣置龍潭堡。

translations.literal: Edict: Longtan fort was established in Xupu county, Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou’s Xupu county was ordered to build Longtan fort.

sentences.zh: 是月，潁州、壽州甘露降。

translations.literal: That month: sweet dew fell in Ying and Shou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month, sweet dew appeared in Yingzhou and Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，詔瘞漢州暴骸。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin, edict: exposed corpses in Han prefecture were to be buried.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiayin: Hanzhou’s unburied dead were ordered interred.

sentences.zh: 日中有黑子。

translations.literal: A black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A sunspot appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以瀘州夷乞弟犯邊，詔王光祖等討之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: because the Luzhou Yi Qidi raided the border, Wang Guangzu and others were ordered to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Qidi’s Luzhou Yi raid brought orders for Wang Guangzu to campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔定解鹽歲額。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: the annual quota for Jie salt was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the yearly Jie salt quota was set.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，滄州饑，發倉粟振之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Cang prefecture was in famine; granary grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, famine in Cangzhou was met from state granaries.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午朔，董氈遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu, new moon: Dong Zhan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengwu new moon: Dong Zhan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔給地葬畿內寄菆之喪，無所歸者官瘞之。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: land was granted to bury coffins temporarily stored within the capital region; those with no kin were buried by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the court granted plots for stranded coffins near the capital and buried the kinless.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，親試禮部進士。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Ministry of Rites jinshi were examined in person.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the emperor personally tested Ministry of Rites graduates.

sentences.zh: 壬午，試特奏名進士及武舉。

translations.literal: Day renwu: specially presented jinshi and military candidates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, special-entry graduates and military candidates were tested.

sentences.zh: 癸未，試諸科明法。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the various Mingfa law examinations were held.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Mingfa law examinations were held.

sentences.zh: 賜董氈緡錢、銀帛、對衣、金帶等物。

translations.literal: Dong Zhan was granted cash, silks, paired robes, a gold belt, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhan received cash, silks, court dress, and a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔雄州兩輸戶南徙者諭令復業。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: households in Xiong prefecture that paid tribute to two states and had moved south were urged to return to their holdings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Xiongzhou families that served two courts and had fled south were told to go home.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，疏汴、洛。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Bian and Luo rivers were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Bian and Luo canals were cleared.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，幸金明池觀水嬉，宴射瓊林苑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: he visited the Golden Bright Pool to watch water games and feasted with archery at Qionglin Park.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinchou: he watched water games at Golden Bright Pool and feasted at Qionglin.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遼遣蕭晟等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Liao sent Xiao Sheng and others to congratulate the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Liao envoys came for the Shared Heaven festival.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，陳升之以檢校太尉依前同中書門下平章事、鎮江軍節度使、上柱國、秀國公致仕。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Chen Shengshi, honorary grand marshal, retained as chief councilor, Zhenjiang army military commissioner, pillar of state, and Duke of Xiu, retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Chief Councilor Chen Shengshi retired as Duke of Xiu and Zhenjiang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，陳升之卒。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Chen Shengshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Chen Shengshi died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定正旦御殿儀。

translations.literal: Day guihai: New Year audience rites at the main hall were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, New Year court ceremony was codified.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔增審刑院詳議、詳斷官，罷刑部校法官。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: review posts for deliberation and judgment at the Court for Reviewing Punishments were increased, and the Ministry of Justice proofreading judges were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the review court gained deliberation posts and Justice proofreaders were cut.

sentences.zh: 是月，南康軍甘露降，眉州生瑞竹。

translations.literal: That month: sweet dew fell in Nankang army; auspicious bamboo grew in Mei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Nankang saw sweet dew and Meizhou produced lucky bamboo.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，順州蠻叛，峒兵討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi: Shun prefecture tribes rebelled; cave militia put them down.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingzi: Shunzhou tribes rose and cave troops crushed them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔以濮安懿王三夫人並稱王夫人，祔濮園。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: the three consorts of Prince Pu’an Yi were all styled Lady of the Prince and enshrined at the Pu garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Prince Pu’an Yi’s three consorts were enshrined at Pu Garden as princesses.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太子太師致仕趙概上所集《諫林》。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: retired grand mentor Zhao Gai presented his collected Remonstrance Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, retired mentor Zhao Gai submitted his Remonstrance Forest.

sentences.zh: 甲申，元絳罷知亳州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Yuan Jiang was dismissed as Bozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yuan Jiang left the Bozhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔安南軍死事孤寡廩給之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, edict: orphans of those who died on campaign in Annan were to receive grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Annan war orphans were put on state grain rolls.

sentences.zh: 戊子，御史中丞蔡確參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: censor-in-chief Cai Que was made participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Cai Que joined the participating council.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，廣西捕斬儂智春，執其妻子以獻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: in Guangxi Nong Zhichun was captured and beheaded; his wife and children were presented.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: Guangxi troops killed Nong Zhichun and sent up his family.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命蔡確參定編修《傳法寶錄》。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Cai Que was ordered to help compile and revise the Record of the Transmission of the Dharma.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Cai Que was assigned to the Dharma Transmission record.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔五路帥臣、副總管軍臣僚各舉任將領及大使臣者二人。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: on each of the five circuits, commanders, deputy commanders, and staff were each to recommend two men fit to command armies or serve as grand envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, every circuit commander was to name two men fit for field command or embassy.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，清汴成。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Qingbian canal was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Qingbian canal project finished.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔鎮甯軍節度使、魏國公宗懿追封舒王。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: Zhenning army military commissioner and Duke of Wei Zong Yi was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zong Yi was posthumously made Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 是月，南康軍甘露降，忠州雨豆。

translations.literal: That month: sweet dew fell in Nankang army; beans rained in Zhong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Nankang had sweet dew and Zhongzhou saw a bean rain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，張方平以太子少師致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiaxu: Zhang Fangping retired as junior mentor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiaxu: Zhang Fangping retired as heir-apparent tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詳定朝會儀。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: court audience rites were detailed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, court audience ceremony was codified.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命中書句考四方詔獄。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Secretariat was ordered to examine imperial edict cases on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Secretariat was told to audit edict cases empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以淮康軍節度使宗暉同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Huai’kang army military commissioner Zong Hui was made chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Zong Hui of Huai’kang army entered the chief councilorship.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詳定郊廟禮儀。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: suburban and temple ritual was detailed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, suburban and temple rites were codified.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳州芝草生，南賓縣雨豆，瓊州甘露降。

translations.literal: That month: lucky fungus grew in Chen prefecture; beans rained in Nanbin county; sweet dew fell in Qiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chenzhou had lucky fungus, Nanbin a bean rain, and Qiongzhou sweet dew.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔，夏人寇綏德城，都監李浦敗之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen, new moon: Xi Xia raided Suide city; garrison commander Li Pu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingshen new moon: Tanguts hit Suide; Li Pu beat them back.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，分涇原路兵爲十一將。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Jingyuan circuit troops were divided into eleven commands.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jingyuan forces were split into eleven commands.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，復八作司爲東、西兩司，各置監官，文臣一員、武臣二員。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Eight Works Office was restored as eastern and western offices, each with supervisors—one civil and two military.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Eight Works Office was split east and west with one civil and two military supervisors each.

sentences.zh: 遣李清臣等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Li Qingchen and others were dispatched to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and the new year.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingchen’s party was sent to congratulate the Liao emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔：「增太學生舍爲八十齋，齋三十人。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: “Increase Imperial University dormitories to eighty halls, thirty students per hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, an edict ordered eighty Imperial University halls of thirty students each.

sentences.zh: 外舍生二千人，內舍生三百人。

translations.literal: Outer dormitory students two thousand; inner dormitory students three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand outer students and three hundred inner students were set.

sentences.zh: 月一私試，歲一公試，補內舍生。

translations.literal: Monthly private examinations and yearly public examinations were to advance students to the inner dormitory.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly private and yearly public exams would promote students into the inner dormitory.

sentences.zh: 間歲一舍試，補上舍生。

translations.literal: Every other year a dormitory examination would advance students to the upper dormitory.”
translations.idiomatic: Biennial dormitory exams would promote men to the upper dormitory.”

sentences.zh: 」以潁州爲順昌軍節度。

translations.literal: Ying prefecture was made Shunchang army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou became Shunchang army circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，曹州生瑞谷，河陽生芝草。

translations.literal: That month: lucky grain grew in Cao prefecture; lucky fungus grew in Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Caozhou had lucky grain and Heyang lucky fungus.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，降順昌軍囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: prisoners in Shunchang army had crimes reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao: Shunchang prisoners were commuted and lesser offenders freed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，西南龍蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the southwestern Long tribe came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the southwestern Long tribe presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大宴集英殿。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: a great feast was held in the Hall of Assembling Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, a grand banquet was held at Assembling Excellence Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，進婕妤朱氏爲昭容。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Lady of Handsome Favor Zhu was advanced to Lady of Bright Countenance.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zhu of Handsome Favor was promoted to Bright Countenance.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，出《馬步射格鬥法》頒諸軍。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Manual of Horse and Foot Archery and Close Combat was issued to all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, archery and melee drill regulations went out to every army.

sentences.zh: 甲午，西南羅蕃、方蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the southwestern Luo and Fang tribes came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the southwestern Luo and Fang tribes presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，西南石蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: the southwestern Shi tribe came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingshen: the southwestern Shi tribe sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，置籍田令。

translations.literal: Day guimao: a registrar of the sacred field was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, a sacred-field registrar was appointed.

sentences.zh: 詔立水居船戶，五戶至十戶爲一甲。

translations.literal: Edict: boat households living on the water were registered; five to ten households formed one tithing.
translations.idiomatic: Boat-dwelling families were registered in groups of five to ten households.

sentences.zh: 戊申，交阯歸所掠民，詔以順州賜之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Jiaozhi returned captives it had seized; an edict granted it Shun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Jiaozhi returned prisoners and received Shun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太皇太后疾，上不視事。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; the emperor ceased holding court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷朝謁景靈宮，命輔臣禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: audience at the Jingling Palace was suspended; chief ministers were ordered to pray at Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Jingling audiences stopped and ministers prayed at Heaven, Earth, temples, and altars.

sentences.zh: 減天下囚死罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Death sentences throughout the realm were reduced one degree; those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences were commuted empire-wide and lesser prisoners freed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Grand Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Grand Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔易太皇太后園陵曰山陵。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: the Grand Empress Dowager’s garden tomb was renamed a mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, her garden tomb was redesignated a mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以群臣七上表，始聽政。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: because the ministers had memorialized seven times, he at last resumed hearing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, after seven ministerial pleas, he resumed government.

sentences.zh: 命王珪爲山陵使。

translations.literal: Wang Gui was appointed mountain-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui was named commissioner for the mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，始御崇政殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: he first held audience in the Hall of Promoting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guimao: he reopened court at Promoting Governance Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雨土。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: soil rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, soil fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，御史中丞李定上《國子監敕式令》並《學令》凡百四十條。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: censor-in-chief Li Ding presented the Directorate of Education statutes and school regulations—one hundred forty articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi: Li Ding submitted one hundred forty Directorate of Education rules.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復置御史六察。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the six censorial investigators were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the six censorial investigation posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遼遣蕭甯等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Liao sent Xiao Ning and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 是月，全州芝草生，桂州甘露降。

translations.literal: That month: lucky fungus grew in Quan prefecture; sweet dew fell in Gui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Quanzhou had lucky fungus and Guizhou sweet dew.
